name: guild-review-pr-tree
description: In a review-*.code-workspace window, opens the GitHub Pull Request side bar and the PR's changes as the worktree has them, again each time its head moves.

guild.reviewPullRequest.description: The pull request this review window is for (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/pull/<number>); Guild writes it into the review workspace.

guild.reviewBase.description: The branch the pull request merges into; the changes view diffs the worktree's HEAD against its merge base with origin/<this>. Guild writes it.
